description: The three profile links — Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn — as one artifact: each an accessible link naming the platform, opening in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer"; the platforms' official icons from their brand resource centres, unaltered, in the footer's ink; the URLs are data (content/identity.json), never code, and the same three go into the Organization structured data as sameAs. A link is a link: no platform pixel, SDK or embedded feed loads with it (addendum 7).

properties.name: icons
properties.description: official when the platform's supplied asset is at public/brand/social/<platform>.svg; the platform's name as text until then

disabled.reason: an embedded feed or page plugin sets cookies and needs consent, and it would bring customer rooms onto the site against the image decision 4b2489df — no embedded feeds on the site
